from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection and its citation relationships to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")
    citation_quotes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Verbatim excerpts from the reference list that cite other provided papers")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
